content.text: Plan the Mission: Mun Shot v2. launch(lexicon("target_ap", 80000)) is the example in the docs, not the flight.

input.script:
local res is launch(lexicon("target_ap", 80000, "turn_shape", 0.45, "stage_limit", 3)). if res:success { set res to circularize(lexicon("at", "ap")). }
addons:claudia:report(res).
